trades.reasoning: HPE shows every momentum signal at once (RSI 60.5, MACD crossover with a rising histogram, price about 6% above its SMA-20), and as an enterprise hardware name it adds less to the semiconductor exposure we already hold through OLED.
ASX also shows every momentum signal (RSI 56.3, rising MACD, price above SMA-20), and its low share price lets us use whatever cash is left after HPE on this risk-on day.

decisions.briefing: Markets rallied hard today: the NASDAQ rose 6.3% and the S&P 500 rose 4.6%, a clear risk-on signal. Our strategy notes say to put idle cash to work on strong up days, so we are using the $646 in cash to start positions in HPE and ASX, which fills two of our three open slots. All seven existing positions stay in place, and their automatic stop-loss and profit-target rules keep running.

market_education.summary_en: US stocks rose broadly today, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ up 6.3% and the S&P 500 up 4.6%, one of the strongest single-day moves in a long time. No news headlines came with today's data, so we cannot name a specific cause; moves this large usually follow a major surprise on interest rates, inflation, or policy. The strength was led by semiconductors and AI hardware: nearly every name in our top candidate list, including MU, NVDA, INTC, and DELL, is trading above its 20-day average with a bullish MACD.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面急升，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數大漲6.3%，標普500指數亦升4.6%，屬近期罕見的單日強勢表現。由於今日數據未附帶相關新聞標題，暫未能確認觸發升市的具體消息，但如此大幅度的升幅，通常源於利率、通脹或政策方面的重大意外。升勢由半導體及AI硬件板塊領軍，MU、NVDA、INTC、DELL等候選股份幾乎全部企穩20日均線之上，MACD亦呈好淡交叉的利好訊號。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money into riskier assets like growth and technology stocks, which pushes the major indexes up sharply. Today's 6.3% jump in the NASDAQ is a clear example. Our rule is to put idle cash to work on days like this, while still letting stop-losses protect us if the rally reverses.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 所謂「風險偏好」（Risk-On）市況，是指投資者信心充足，資金湧入科技股、增長股等較高風險資產，推動主要指數大幅上揚。今日納指急升6.3%，正是典型例子。我們的策略是在這類日子把閒置現金投入市場，同時保留止蝕機制，以防升勢逆轉時受損。
